# Prerequisites {.unnumbered}

If you run `quarto -v` in your terminal, you will most likely get a response similar to 

```bash
user@office:~$ quarto -v
bash: quarto: command not found
```

This means that Quarto is not installed on your system. To install Quarto, you can follow the instructions provided in the [official Quarto documentation](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/).
